title: Little Haunts Club: A Very Odd Halloween — 15 Printable Coloring Pages
subtitle: A VERY ODD HALLOWEEN
purpose: A carefully art-directed first seasonal Etsy validation product with 15 distinct spooky-cute character archetypes and individually planned scenes. Each page has a readable mini-story, grounded props, open coloring regions, and a deliberate reason for each supporting detail.
audience: older children, teens, and adults who enjoy cozy spooky illustration
visual_bible: Original spooky-cute storybook coloring art for older children, teens, and adults: friendly oddball creatures, small comic mishaps, cozy settings, clear silhouettes, and detail with a purpose. The illustration uses crisp black contour lines on pure white paper, confident outer lines, a few thinner inner contours, broad white coloring areas, and moderate detail that is satisfying at printed page size. Solid black is limited to small accents such as pupils, noses, or tiny markings; clothing, fur, feathers, bones, wings, furniture, and props have clearly enclosed white interiors to color. Frame the portrait scene with a simple rounded rectangle and a generous white margin. Every prop is visibly supported, attached, or held by the character using it. Use warm-hearted expressions and an amusing scene-specific story; never rely on repeated floating bats as filler.
prompt_strategy: Per the FLUX.2 prompting guide, each prompt starts with the main subject and action, then specifies critical line-art style, then adds spatial relationships and scene context. Prompts describe the intended printable linework affirmatively. Each page has a unique art-direction rationale and a targeted defect checklist.
art_direction_principles: One distinct creature archetype per page; ghosts and cats are recurring accents, not the whole cast.
Every page has one focal action and three to five supporting objects that explain the setting.
Small decorative details such as flowers, portraits, pumpkins, a fireplace, a fence, or a framed picture belong to the scene and help composition.
Avoid black-filled environmental panels; backgrounds and character surfaces remain open white coloring regions.
Keep solid black only as a small accent; wings, fur, bones, clothing, bandages, and large props should stay colorable.
Ground and connect every prop; describe object support and attachment explicitly.
Use a simple rounded border, medium-large detail, clear object separation, and a generous printable margin consistently.

research_notes.source: Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 Prompting Guide
research_notes.takeaway: Uses Subject + Action + Style + Context; word order matters; describe desired output instead of relying on negative prompts; structured scene planning is useful for production.
Current ages-7+ book description promotes 45 hand-drawn pages with large bold designs and a varied cast including cozy ghosts, grim reapers, and zombie cats.
A six-page printable listing uses distinct Halloween archetypes such as mummy, vampire, witch, Frankenstein-style monster, cat, and bat, showing that variety can be the product's promise.
Example listings show variety across home scenes and creatures; the strongest lesson is scene diversity plus readable props, not just a higher page count.

Preview imagery includes distinct archetypes and scene ideas such as skeleton at home, mummy, stitched doll, zombie, bride, and grim reaper. Used only as genre-level market research; new prompts use original compositions.

listing.title: Cute Spooky Halloween Coloring Pages for Kids, Teens & Adults — 15 Original Printable PDF + PNG
listing.tagline: A little strange, a little cozy, and full of Halloween charm
listing.description: Meet the Little Haunts Club: a curious cast of friendly spooky neighbors, from a ghostly tailor and patchwork monster to a masked crow apothecary, cozy skeleton reader, tiny witch, vampire baker, and more. Each page tells a small, funny story with pumpkins, flowers, picture frames, cottage details, and other purposeful accents. Original black-outline illustrations with open white areas for your own colors.
listing.price_test: Launch at $2.99 for the initial seasonal validation test. If listing views, favorites, and conversion are healthy, test $3.49; expand the pack or create a companion product before raising the price substantially.

Build the scene around one obvious focal action, with medium-large background details that enrich the story without clutter. Use a portrait composition inside a simple rounded-rectangle frame with a generous white margin. Keep props physically grounded and connected: furniture rests on the floor, shelves have clear supports, frames hang on walls, and objects sit on visible surfaces. Arrange the table, stool, cat, and wall frame with clear breathing room.
